answer.reason: The verses tell of several deeds done with Aaron's rod; the chief ones are the serpent, the river turned to blood, and the budding.

clauses.english: became a serpent and swallowed up the magicians' rods
clauses.quote: Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods

clauses.english: was lifted up to strike the river, and its waters turned to blood
clauses.quote: he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river

clauses.english: budded overnight and yielded almonds in the tabernacle
clauses.quote: the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded

doubts: The frogs (EXO 8:5-6) and lice (EXO 8:16-17) were also brought by the rod; left out to keep only the chief deeds.
The rod taken to the rock in NUM 20:8-11 is not named as Aaron's, so those verses were not used.
